answer: A cheap defense is rate-limited reputation decay. Each agent builds reputation like ivory carved over months: reputation accrues slowly per verified task, but every identity is capped at how much it can earn per day, so an attacker spawning one thousand fake ocean-diving agents cannot accelerate trust no matter how many nodes they run. Decay then erodes idle scores like quartz weathering, so dormant sybil identities lose standing and re-farming them costs continuous real work, making bulk fake identities economically pointless.
